submission.text: Since this morning's update, CSV export fails with 'Error 500' for every user on our workspace. Our whole operations team (250 people) relies on the daily export to plan shipments and we have nothing today. We need this fixed ASAP.

rationale: The feedback states 'CSV export fails with Error 500 for every user' and 'our whole operations team relies on the daily export,' indicating a core functionality is blocked for a large group. The request for ASAP resolution further signals critical urgency.

guideline.title: Handling Bug Reports
steps: Confirm the affected feature, platform, and steps to reproduce; ask for screenshots if missing.
Check past tickets for the same issue and link duplicates.
If the bug blocks core functionality for an Enterprise customer or affects multiple customers, escalate per POL-ESC-003.
Otherwise, file an engineering ticket with severity matching the urgency and give the customer the ticket ID.
Consider service credits per POL-CREDIT-007 for prolonged outages.

policies.title: Support Response SLA
policies.text: First-response targets by tier: Enterprise - 1 hour for critical/high urgency, 4 business hours otherwise. Pro - 4 business hours for critical/high urgency, 1 business day otherwise. Free - best effort, target 3 business days. Critical issues for any tier must be acknowledged within 1 hour. A breach of the Enterprise SLA must be reported to the account manager.

policies.title: Escalation Rules
policies.text: Escalate to Engineering on-call immediately when a bug blocks core functionality for an Enterprise customer or affects multiple customers. Escalate to the Security team for any suspected data exposure or account compromise. Escalate to Legal for threats of legal action or regulatory complaints. Escalate to the CS Lead when a customer has two or more unresolved tickets older than 14 days. Escalations must include the ticket ID, customer tier, and a summary of impact.

policies.title: Service Credit Policy
policies.text: Enterprise customers are entitled to a service credit of 10 percent of the monthly fee for each confirmed incident where a core feature is unavailable for more than 4 hours. Pro customers may receive a goodwill credit of up to 1 month at CS Lead discretion. Credits are applied to the next invoice and are not paid as cash.

content:
- The customer, Alice Nguyen (C001), is an enterprise-tier client from Northwind Logistics with 250 seats and a high monthly spend; their operations team is fully blocked by the CSV export bug (customer_id: C001).
- The issue is classified as a critical bug affecting all users in the workspace, which per SOP-BUG-01 and policy POL-ESC-003, requires immediate escalation to Engineering on-call.
- Enterprise SLA (POL-SLA-002) mandates a first response within 1 hour for critical issues, and any breach must be reported to the account manager.
- If the outage lasts more than 4 hours, the customer is entitled to a 10% service credit on their monthly fee (POL-CREDIT-007).
- The CS guideline (SOP-BUG-01) also requires confirming the affected feature, checking for duplicate tickets, and providing the customer with a ticket ID and status updates.
